title: vascular tower · biomorphic 3D growth
concept: 5gm's 3D differential growth, but the polyline is rendered as a vascular tube. Thick at the base (trunk vessel feeds everything above), tapers to capillary thin at the top. Subtle 60-bpm radial pulse via sin(t*1.6). Small bulges every 1/22 of length suggest junction/fork points (vessel nodes). Lit with directional + ambient + cool rim — so the curvature reads as anatomy, not just a curve.
